title: Good design, but …
text: Good design, but …. I thought I would love this, and I did until I got up close. The wood had a strong, kind of chemical like odor that was too much for me.  I returned it rather than hope it went away with time.  This is hardly the first time odors on something I bought online were too strong so maybe it’s just me. Otherwise I really liked the bread box a lot.
